lines.note: I got to pricing and could judge it, but only after squinting at the washed-out Get started button and ignoring a hero headline I could never explain to my client.

blockers: The main Get started button is white text on pale blue and is hard to read, so I would not trust it on a projector.
The Sign up free button on pricing points to just # so it goes nowhere.
lines.note: The first button I zoomed into is the weakest thing on the page, and that alone makes me distrust the rest.
Plans and the $24 price are clear, but Team is just Contact us with no number and the hero never says plainly what the tool is, so I had to hunt in the feature headings.
